## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tried it with `npm start`
- [ ] If this touches `credentials.ts`, `oauth.ts` or `statusline.ts`: tests cover the new behaviour,
      and no path can write an empty token or drop unrelated keys
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (or explained why one is needed)
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour changed
